c74object.name: evi_bp
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Reimplementation of Pd 'bp~' filter
c74object.description:
evi_bp is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_bp.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_biquads.genexpr, evi_biquads_coeffs.genexpr, evi_biquads_filters.genexpr
evi_bp is also available in MSP as: evi.bp~.
A linear twopole resonant bandpass filter, a port of [bp~] from Pd and therefore a direct form biquad. Similar to reson~ and evi.reson~ but with no feedforward gains and thus a special and smooth alternative to those filters. Like reson etc it can take very high Q values which is one of it's primary use cases. [bp~] is basically a control rate version of [vcf~] from Pd, which is also ported in evieve as evi.vcf~.

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ input, cutoff, gain, q } }

geninlet.name: cutoff
geninlet.digest: in Hz @min samplerate*0.00022 @max samplerate*0.458334. Center frequency of the resonant peak.

geninlet.name: gain
geninlet.digest: in dB @min -24 @max 24 @default 0. ± gain in dB if @filter attribute == 1.

geninlet.name: q
geninlet.digest: @min 0.1 @default 1. Filter resonance. Can be increasingly high values (e.g. 10000).

attribute.name: filter
attribute.description: Gain filter off/on. If off (the default) identical to Pd [bp~] (no gain inlet). If on, ± gain inlet takes effect. Switching this also resets internal filter (biquad) state.
